description: The for rewrite (fz-sc8.17, src/compiler2/source_sugar.rs) refuses a bitstring generator <<x <- bin>> with a QuotedSourceError naming the form. Elixir iterates the binary by the pattern's segment sizes and skips a trailing remainder that does not match. Build it in the rewrite over the existing bitstring pattern support; oracle fixtures on three paths against elixir; the distiller does not use it.
title: for comprehension bitstring generators
